name: sis-backend
description: Unity SIS Backend — Finance, HR, Material (Express + PostgreSQL)

scripts.db:verify: node -e "require('dotenv').config();const {pool}=require('./config/db');pool.query(`SELECT 'users' t,count(*)::int c FROM users UNION ALL SELECT 'fin_coa',count(*) FROM fin_coa UNION ALL SELECT 'fin_transactions',count(*) FROM fin_transactions UNION ALL SELECT 'hr_employees',count(*) FROM hr_employees`).then(r=>{r.rows.forEach(x=>console.log(x.t,x.c));return pool.end()}).catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exit(1)})"
